reason: I have one or two chairs and I'm cutting hair myself all day. I can see who's in the chair and what's in the drawer, and UPI already shows me the takings, so attendance, leave and stylist dashboards are for a bigger salon. ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month is about ₹17,000 in the first year, which is a lot for my size.
objection: My hands are busy with customers. Nobody is going to stop mid-cut to type a mobile number and bill every service in an app, so after a week it would just sit unused while I keep paying ₹999.
would_change_my_mind: A small-shop plan around ₹299 a month with no setup fee, just the WhatsApp due-back reminders and the refer-a-friend ₹100. That part could actually bring customers back, and I'd try it.
